posts.content_md: I can't remember if I've mentioned here that my collection of vintage lasers is available for viewing on the web via a private Google Site. There are currently 170 lasers, another 170 laser and holography related artifacts, and lots of books and other publications in it, mostly from the 1960s and '70s. Anyone interested in checking it out just needs to send me an email address that I can put on the list for viewing. A gmail address is best. I have a second private site showing all of my hologram collection too.
